dataset.why_this_snapshot: Largest frozen generator-3.3 snapshot already built and readable. The 45-day bench default (days=45, volume_scale=0.6, seed=2026, p_corrupt_file=0.1) was not on disk.

selection_rule: Pool: load_cases on snapshot 98e61f03e594 (hand-written + generated families + authored), minus the 27 heldout_hard_1 questions, minus anything tagged grokbot-r1, minus any split labelled validation or test. 128 loaded, 27 held out, 0 grokbot-r1, 0 split labels, pool 101. Screen-1 (research/screening_results_1.md, research/screening_questions.json) has config-level Haiku/Sonnet accuracy only and no per-question pass/fail, so the pass-rate ranking could not be computed. Fallback: rank by difficulty (hard, then medium, then easy) and break ties by sha256(question_id) hex. Take 30. The pool has 42 hard questions, so all 30 selected are hard.
